## Copilot review overview ### 🟡 Changes recommended Unresolved state-consistency, no-op handling, and refresh issues remain. **Review effort:** Lite **Findings:** 1
Open (3) - [Make kit and record updates atomic](#discussion_r721) · New - [Cover the bundle filter at the API level](#discussion_r722) · New - [Treat empty update responses as no-ops](#discussion_r723) · New
What changed in this PR Scopes per-bundle admin actions by bundle identifier. | File | Summary | |---|---| | `src/admin/Bundles.js` | Critical (1 vote): kit requests can leave records inconsistent when the record update fails. Moderate (2 votes): empty update results are reported as success. Moderate (1 vote each): missing identifiers do not refresh the table, and one path also leaves the dialog open. | | `server/api/bundles.js` | Moderate (2 votes): add an HTTP-level test that the bundle filter is preserved. |
